csr.title: CSR
csr.reason: CSR is a standard abbreviation for Customer Service Representative, which is the same role.

call centre agent.title: Call Centre Agent
call centre agent.reason: This role involves the same voice-based customer support duties as the target job.

cleaning staff.title: Cleaning Staff
cleaning staff.reason: This role involves manual labor and is unrelated to voice-based customer support.

customer care executive.title: Customer Care Executive
customer care executive.reason: This is a synonymous job title for a customer support executive.

customer support executive.title: Customer Support Executive
customer support executive.reason: This is the exact same job title as the one being filled.

customer support representative.title: Customer Support Representative
customer support representative.reason: This is a standard title for the same customer support function.

data entry operator.title: Data Entry Operator
data entry operator.reason: While primarily administrative, it involves computer skills and office environment experience that can transfer to support roles.
